compress.title: Compress Images Online Free
compress.subtitle: Reduce image file size without losing quality. Fast, private, free.
compress.howTitle: How to Compress Images Without Losing Quality
compress.howDesc: Our smart compression engine uses advanced algorithms to reduce file size while preserving visual quality. Simply upload your images, adjust the quality slider, and download.

faq.a: Image compression reduces file size by removing redundant or less important data while preserving visual quality.

faq.q: How to reduce image size without losing quality?
faq.a: Use lossy compression with high quality settings (80-90%) for the best balance between file size and visual quality.
All processing happens directly in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

convert.title: Convert Images Online Free
convert.subtitle: Convert PNG to JPG, WebP, and more — instantly in your browser.
convert.howDesc: Upload your image, select the target format, and download the converted file. All conversion happens in your browser.

faq.a: We support JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF formats for both input and output.
Converting between lossless formats (like PNG) preserves full quality. Converting to JPG applies light compression.

resize.title: Resize Images Online Free
resize.subtitle: Resize images to exact pixel dimensions or percentages.
resize.howDesc: Enter your desired dimensions, toggle aspect ratio lock if needed, and resize your image instantly.

faq.q: Can I resize multiple images at once?
faq.a: Yes! Upload multiple images and they'll all be resized to the same dimensions.
Downscaling is lossless. Upscaling uses bicubic interpolation for the best possible quality.

removeBackground.title: Remove Image Background Online Free
removeBackground.subtitle: Remove backgrounds in your browser, preview the transparent result, and download a PNG.
removeBackground.privateHint: The image stays on your device while the browser processes it.
removeBackground.resultPlaceholder: The transparent preview will appear here.
removeBackground.error: We could not remove the background. Try another image or reload the page.
removeBackground.howTitle: How to remove an image background
removeBackground.howDesc: Upload one image, run the background remover, then compare the original with the transparent PNG preview before downloading the result.

faq.q: Do my images upload to a server?
faq.a: No. The removal runs in your browser from the file you select.

faq.q: Why is the download a PNG?
faq.a: PNG supports transparency, so the removed background stays transparent after download.
Photos with a clear subject and contrast between foreground and background usually produce the cleanest result.

qr.title: QR Code Generator Free
qr.subtitle: Generate QR codes for URLs, text, or contact info instantly.
qr.howDesc: Type or paste your URL or text, customize the colors, and download your QR code in PNG format.

faq.q: Is the QR code free to use?
faq.a: Yes, all QR codes generated here are free and can be used for commercial purposes.
Static QR codes never expire. Once generated, they work forever.

imageToPdf.title: Image to PDF Converter Free
imageToPdf.subtitle: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images into one PDF directly in your browser.
imageToPdf.howTitle: How to convert images to PDF
imageToPdf.howDesc: Upload one or more images, keep them in the order you want, then create and download a single PDF file. The conversion runs in your browser.

faq.q: Do my images upload to a server?
faq.a: No. The PDF is created in your browser from the images you select.
The tool supports common browser-readable formats such as JPG, PNG, and WebP.
Yes. Upload multiple images and they will be placed into the PDF in the order shown.

common.previewHint: Click pages to select them. The page range updates automatically.
common.visualPreviewHint: Preview how the page effect will look before downloading.
common.invalidPdf: We could not read this PDF. Try another file.
common.error: We could not process this PDF. Encrypted or damaged PDFs may not work.

mergePdf.title: Merge PDF Files Online Free
mergePdf.subtitle: Combine multiple PDF files into one downloadable PDF directly in your browser.
mergePdf.howDesc: Upload two or more PDF files, keep them in the order shown, then merge and download a single PDF.

faq.q: Do my PDFs upload to a server?
faq.a: No. The merge runs in your browser from the files you select.

faq.q: Can I merge more than two PDFs?
faq.a: Yes. Add multiple PDF files and they will be combined in the order shown.

splitPdf.title: Split PDF Online Free
splitPdf.subtitle: Extract selected pages or split every page of a PDF into separate files.
splitPdf.pageCount: {count, plural, one {# page found} other {# pages found}}
splitPdf.howDesc: Upload a PDF, enter pages such as 1-3, 5 to extract a new PDF, or split every page into a ZIP of separate PDF files.

faq.q: Can I extract a page range?
faq.a: Yes. Use commas and ranges such as 1-3, 5.

faq.q: What does split every page do?
faq.a: It creates a ZIP file containing one PDF for each page.

compressPdf.title: Compress PDF Online Free
compressPdf.subtitle: Reduce PDF size in your browser with compact saving and stronger image-based compression.
compressPdf.compressionHint: Percentages are estimates. Text-heavy or already optimized PDFs may not reach the same reduction.

light.name: Light compression
light.desc: Optimizes the PDF structure without turning pages into images.

balanced.name: Balanced compression
balanced.desc: Higher resolution with a medium file size for reading and sharing.

strong.name: Strong compression
strong.desc: Smaller files with more visible quality reduction.

maximum.name: Maximum compression
maximum.desc: Smallest practical size for image-heavy PDFs.

compressPdf.howDesc: Upload a PDF and Toolzee will try compact PDF saving first, then a stronger browser-based compression that redraws pages as JPEG images when it creates a smaller file.

faq.q: Why did my PDF not get smaller?
faq.a: Some PDFs are already compressed, mostly text, or use optimized images. Stronger compression can reduce image quality and may make text no longer selectable.
Yes. The optimization runs in your browser and does not require an account.

pdfToImage.title: PDF to Image Converter Free
pdfToImage.subtitle: Convert every page of a PDF into PNG images and download them together as a ZIP file.
pdfToImage.pageCount: {count, plural, one {# page found} other {# pages found}}
pdfToImage.howTitle: How to convert PDF to images
pdfToImage.howDesc: Upload a PDF, choose the image quality, then convert the pages into PNG images packaged in a ZIP file.

faq.a: The tool creates PNG images for clear text and page previews.
Yes. Every PDF page is rendered as a separate PNG image.

rotatePdf.title: Rotate PDF Online Free
rotatePdf.subtitle: Rotate all pages or selected PDF pages directly in your browser.
rotatePdf.rangePlaceholder: Leave empty for all pages, or enter 1-3, 5
rotatePdf.pageCount: {count, plural, one {# page found} other {# pages found}}
rotatePdf.howDesc: Upload a PDF, choose all pages or enter a page range, then rotate and download the corrected file.

faq.q: Can I rotate only some pages?
faq.a: Yes. Leave the page range empty for every page, or enter ranges such as 1-3, 5.

faq.q: Do files upload to a server?
faq.a: No. The rotation runs in your browser.

removePdfPages.title: Remove Pages from PDF Free
removePdfPages.subtitle: Delete unwanted pages from a PDF and download a clean copy.
removePdfPages.pageCount: {count, plural, one {# page found} other {# pages found}}
removePdfPages.howDesc: Upload a PDF, enter the pages you want to delete, then create a new PDF containing only the remaining pages.

faq.q: Can I remove multiple page ranges?
faq.a: Yes. Use commas and ranges such as 2, 4-6.
No. At least one page must remain in the output PDF.

extractPdfPages.title: Extract PDF Pages Free
extractPdfPages.subtitle: Pull selected pages out of a PDF and save them as a separate file.
extractPdfPages.pageCount: {count, plural, one {# page found} other {# pages found}}
extractPdfPages.howDesc: Upload a PDF, enter the page numbers or ranges you need, then download those pages as a new PDF.

faq.a: Yes. Enter pages like 1, 3, 8-10.

faq.q: Does extraction change the original file?
faq.a: No. It creates a new downloadable PDF.

addPageNumbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Free
addPageNumbers.subtitle: Add simple page numbers to a PDF at the top or bottom of each page.
addPageNumbers.howDesc: Upload a PDF, choose where the numbers should appear, then download a numbered copy.

faq.a: The tool adds a simple current page and total page count format, such as 1 / 5.
No. You download a new PDF with page numbers added.

addWatermark.title: Add Watermark to PDF Free
addWatermark.subtitle: Stamp a text watermark across PDF pages directly in your browser.
addWatermark.howTitle: How to add a PDF watermark
addWatermark.howDesc: Upload a PDF, enter the watermark text, then download a copy with the watermark placed across each page.

faq.q: Can I add a text watermark?
faq.a: Yes. Enter the text you want to stamp across the pages.
A watermark is a visible label, not password protection or encryption.

wordCounter.title: Word Counter Free
wordCounter.subtitle: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading time instantly.
wordCounter.label: Paste or type your text
wordCounter.placeholder: Paste your article, essay, social post, or draft here...
wordCounter.howTitle: How to use the word counter
wordCounter.howDesc: Paste your text into the box and the counters update instantly. You can use it for essays, articles, captions, product copy, and SEO snippets.

faq.a: Yes. It runs in your browser and does not require an account.
Yes. Reading time is estimated using a simple 200 words per minute baseline.

passwordGenerator.title: Password Generator Free
passwordGenerator.subtitle: Generate strong random passwords in your browser with custom length and character options.
passwordGenerator.empty: Click Generate password to create a secure password.
passwordGenerator.howTitle: How to create a strong password
passwordGenerator.howDesc: Choose a length, include a mix of character types, and generate a password. Longer passwords with varied characters are usually stronger.

faq.a: No. Passwords are generated in your browser and are not sent to our server.
A length of 16 characters or more is a good starting point for many everyday accounts.

wifi.title: WiFi QR Code Generator Free
wifi.subtitle: Create a QR code for your WiFi network so guests can connect without typing the password.
wifi.empty: Enter a network name to preview the QR code.
wifi.howTitle: How to make a WiFi QR code
wifi.howDesc: Enter your network name, password, and security type. Guests can scan the QR code to connect on supported devices.

faq.q: Does this share my WiFi password online?
faq.a: No. The QR code is generated in your browser and the password stays inside the code you download.
Most modern phones can scan WiFi QR codes from the camera app or QR scanner.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp QR Code Generator Free
whatsapp.subtitle: Create a QR code that opens a WhatsApp chat with your number and optional message.
whatsapp.empty: Enter a WhatsApp number to preview the QR code.

placeholders.message: Hello, I would like to contact you.

whatsapp.howTitle: How to make a WhatsApp QR code
whatsapp.howDesc: Enter a phone number with country code and an optional message. The QR code opens a WhatsApp chat link when scanned.

faq.q: Do I need to include the country code?
faq.a: Yes. Use digits only with the country code so WhatsApp can open the correct chat.

faq.q: Can I add a prefilled message?
faq.a: Yes. Add a message and it will be included in the WhatsApp chat link.

vcard.title: vCard QR Code Generator Free
vcard.subtitle: Create a QR code for contact details such as name, phone, email, company, and website.
vcard.empty: Enter at least a name, phone, or email to preview the QR code.
vcard.howTitle: How to make a vCard QR code
vcard.howDesc: Fill in the contact details you want to share. When someone scans the QR code, supported devices can save the details as a contact.

faq.q: What is a vCard QR code?
faq.a: It is a QR code that stores contact details in a format many phones can save as a contact.

faq.q: Do I need to fill every field?
faq.a: No. Add only the details you want to include.
